cohort: A total of 155 neonates, 95 without respiratory disorder (control group) and 60 with various respiratory disorders, were included.
finding: PCT demonstrated an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.85 for distinguishing respiratory disorder from controls (sensitivity 66.7%, specificity 93.0% with an optimum cut-off of 3.73 ng/mL), indicating it is a more susceptible diagnostic parameter for respiratory disturbance than CRP and WBC.
